description: Fetch a full supplier profile by slug: identity, location, HS codes, certifications, trade fairs, export markets, and the AI-generated buyer-facing summary + FAQ. Use after search_suppliers to dig into a specific match. When the supplier publishes a Reevol Catalog, a `catalog` block adds its products, certificates, key facts and catalog URL (plus the catalog's own MCP endpoint), and the supplier can be contacted directly with request_introduction, no key needed.

lang.description: Locale for the summary + FAQ (en, zh-CN, es, pt-BR, fr, ar). Default en.

name: get_supplier
title: Get supplier profile
